description: This Java class implements network utility functions for Android, including network interface checks, certificate validation, WiFi info retrieval, DNS status, and socket tagging, primarily used within Chromium's net component.

classes.name: AndroidNetworkLibrary
classes.description: Provides network utility functions for Android within Chromium, including network interface checks, certificate validation, WiFi info, DNS status, and socket tagging.

classes.name: NetworkSecurityPolicyProxy
classes.description: Proxy class to check if cleartext traffic is permitted for specific hosts or globally, with version-specific implementations.

classes.name: SetFileDescriptor

classes.name: SocketFd
classes.description: Custom Socket class that wraps a FileDescriptor to pass to TrafficStats for tagging.

classes.name: SocketImplFd
classes.description: SocketImpl implementation that uses a provided FileDescriptor, without ownership.
